comparison_convention: Native HFSS modal S11/S21, longest continuous S21>=-2dB band; optional 50-ohm plots labeled separately.
solver_and_port_gates: Original adaptive and sweep convergence, source/geometry/port consistency and full finite exported curve remain required.
full_matrix_review: Keep max_sv<=1.001 and reciprocity<=1e-6 for full matrix approval. Failing these triggers localization; it does not alone disqualify the native fundamental response.

fundamental_scoped_release.requires: Same-geometry, same-mesh independent direct checks, raw source hashes, matching mode identity and converged sweep; no blanket transfer to other runs.

threshold_rationale: Existing collector comparisons used 0.005 magnitude RMSE and 0.02GHz edge shift. This review requires 0.005 maximum complex error at selected points, adds dB/peak bounds and a stricter 0.02GHz total bandwidth shift. These are study-specific checks, not universal HFSS tolerances.
design_gates: Separate from numerical review: three identifiable valleys, peak difference<=0.5dB, S11<-10dB and S21>=-2dB between outer valleys, center 6.72+/-0.03GHz for this Fig8 pilot.
limits: Sparse direct checks do not certify every unsampled frequency.
Same-mesh checks test interpolation, not mesh independence.
No full 4x4 network or power/radiation analysis is approved by fundamental-only evidence.
